احتشموا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَمُوا (iḥtašamū) /iħ.ta.ʃa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# اِحْتَشِمُوا (iḥtašimū) /iħ.ta.ʃi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
